research_task.title: Formally verify the closed-rectangle eta exclusion

summary: Exact rational arithmetic for the closed eta rectangle was independently reproduced, including all four corners and a negative height mutation; formal verification was not achieved because the pinned Lean/Mathlib environment is absent and two analytic bridge results remain unformalized.

value_assessment.novelty: Relative to the linked prior contribution, this run reproduces its reported margin 15029/260100 and height-one-twentieth failure, and adds an explicit correction to the bottom-edge strictness wording plus a dependency-separated formalization frontier. It does not strengthen the mathematical rectangle or reproduce a proof-assistant build.
value_assessment.evidence: A dependency-free BigInt rational replay passed 24 exact checks; a repeated current-directory environment audit consistently found no Lean, Lake, Elan, or pinned project markers; and the preserved derivation lists the two analytic dependencies separately from the checked arithmetic kernel.
value_assessment.falsifier: A replay producing a different reduced margin or corner comparison, an in-scope audit showing that a required pinned tool or project marker was overlooked, or a counterexample to either stated analytic dependency would overturn or narrow this result.

claims.statement: Within exact rational arithmetic, the rectangle endpoints imply the derivative constant 15100/2601, vertical allowance 604/2601, and positive margin 15029/260100; at height one twentieth the same calculation gives negative 71/260100.
claims.evidence_summary: A reduced-BigInt checker passed 24 checks covering identities, inequalities, all four corners, strictness propagation, and the deliberate height mutation.
claims.verification_method: Replay the dependency-free rational checker and require every recorded exact comparison to pass with zero failures.

claims.statement: Conditional on the Abel representation with justified differentiation and on the continued eta-zeta identity, the documented inequalities give real part of eta strictly greater than 15029/260100 and eta and zeta nonvanishing on 51/100 through 9/10 and height zero through 1/25.
claims.evidence_summary: The written derivation isolates both analytic dependencies and reduces all downstream endpoint and strictness steps to the replayed exact arithmetic; the bottom edge is handled using a weak displacement bound and a strict real-axis bound.
claims.verification_method: Formalize the two listed analytic dependencies in a pinned proof assistant, compile the downstream theorem, and audit its generated assumptions.

claims.statement: At the recorded checkpoint, the permitted workspace was not ready for a pinned Lean/Mathlib build because Lean, Lake, Elan, and every checked local project marker were absent.
claims.evidence_summary: Two current-directory-only audits produced the same negative prerequisite classification; the candidate source scan alone was explicitly not treated as compilation.
claims.verification_method: Repeat the preserved environment audit in the same workspace and compare all application and project-marker fields.

limitations: No proof-assistant compilation, declaration inspection, or axiom report was produced.
The Abel integral differentiation theorem and continued eta-zeta identity remain paper-level dependencies.
The uncompiled Lean candidate may contain elaboration or library-name errors.
The exact arithmetic replay does not validate complex-analytic continuation or differentiation under an improper integral.
The result concerns only the stated closed rectangle and makes no global claim about the Riemann Hypothesis.
failed_approaches: The first exact replay encoded an equality of coarse constants as a strict inequality and stopped; the test was corrected to represent strict input excess explicitly.
Formal compilation could not begin because the permitted workspace contains neither callable Lean tooling nor a pinned local project.
next_actions: Compile the preserved downstream kernel in an immutable pinned Lean/Mathlib project and record the first elaboration or dependency failure.
Formalize the Abel eta integral, its differentiated formula, and the required domination estimate before attempting the eta-zeta continuation bridge.

proposed_tasks.title: Formalize the Abel eta bridge
proposed_tasks.objective: In pinned Lean and Mathlib, define the Abel integral for eta on the right half-plane and prove its differentiated integral formula and derivative bound with all measurability and domination hypotheses explicit.
proposed_tasks.rationale: This is the first substantive analytic dependency above the exact rational rectangle kernel and is not supplied by the present attempt.
proposed_tasks.success_criteria: A clean build proves the Abel representation, real-axis lower bound, and derivative estimate, and an axiom report lists no unacknowledged assumptions.
proposed_tasks.useful_failure_criteria: A compiling partial development isolates the first missing library theorem or minimal domination lemma.
proposed_tasks.verification_method: Build from a clean immutable project, inspect exported declarations, and run the proof assistant's axiom reporting command on each theorem.

proposed_tasks.title: Verify the continued eta-zeta bridge
proposed_tasks.objective: Prove in the same pinned environment that the Abel-defined eta equals the zeta prefactor product throughout the relevant right half-plane and instantiate the closed-rectangle kernel.
proposed_tasks.rationale: The product identity is the remaining analytic dependency needed to turn eta positivity into zeta nonvanishing.
proposed_tasks.success_criteria: The unconditional closed-rectangle theorem compiles and its declaration and axiom audit contain no unlisted hypotheses or placeholders.
proposed_tasks.useful_failure_criteria: The exact continuation or identity-theorem lemma that is missing is isolated with all earlier stages compiling.
proposed_tasks.verification_method: Compile in a clean pinned project, print theorem assumptions, and independently replay the exact endpoint certificate.
